issues.problem: The sorried BTZ-loop lemma is stated for an ABSTRACT causality with SingularFlatAxioms, while the paper's proof (l.1034-1036) and the obstruction text both rest on 𝔼₀ charts and B21 Prop 1.3 (the tube ⟨γ⟩\{r < r*}) — structure an abstract SFA causality does not carry. 𝔼-morphism' is read as an 𝔼₀-morphism on univ (IsE0Mor f univ), the same class as IsE0CauchyMaximal (DEC-77(c)); (b) the target N is required connected. (b) is necessary, not cosmetic: literally (N any GH E_A-manifold), E_A-maximality fails for every M, since M ↪ M ⊔ M' into a GH disjoint union is a non-surjective embedding; B21's proof writes 'we assume without loss of generality that M and N are connected' (l.1058), which is not without loss of generality for N. This is a DEC-27-type paper finding.
issues.fix: Record (a) as a reading in the REPORT row and the checklist, and (b) as a finding (with the disjoint-union counterexample, optionally proved) under prop:cauchy_abs_max.
